title: MagLIF current-scaling study: 20-MA anchor-load baseline, lumped circuit, and open-circuit voltage trace (Ruiz 2023 Paper II)
description: Baseline (anchor) parameters for the Ellison benchmark-6 replication (arXiv:2504.10760 Sec. 3.6). The Ellison preprint's 'Table 3' citation is a dangling reference -- no such table exists in the preprint -- so the source of record is Ruiz et al. 2023 Paper II itself: the anchor load and circuit element values stated in Sec. III, the Fig. 1 lumped-circuit topology, and a digitization of the Fig. 2 open-circuit voltage trace. Similarity-scaled parameters at other peak currents are generated by verification/b6_ruiz_scaling.py from the committed power-law exponents.

primary_source.authors: D. E. Ruiz, P. F. Schmit, D. A. Yager-Elorriaga, M. R. Gomez, M. R. Weis, C. A. Jennings, A. J. Harvey-Thompson, P. F. Knapp, S. A. Slutz, D. J. Ampleford, K. Beckwith, M. K. Matzen
primary_source.paper: Exploring the parameter space of MagLIF implosions using similarity scaling. II. Current scaling
primary_source.archived_copy: ruiz2023_maglif_current_scaling.pdf at the repo root (local archive beside the Ellison PDF, untracked by repo convention for full-paper PDFs; re-obtain from arXiv:2209.14911v2). The load-bearing Fig. 2 crop IS committed: ground_truth/digitization_review/figures/ruiz_fig2_voltage_trace.png.

secondary_source.paper: Validation of FLASH for magnetically driven inertial confinement fusion target design (Ellison et al. 2025)
secondary_source.note: Defines B6 and restates the Ruiz power-law exponents; its 'Table 3' pointer for the baseline values is dangling (the preprint has no Table 3), so baseline numbers here come from Ruiz Sec. III text.

circuit.topology: Fig. 1 lumped-element model of the Z generator: open-circuit voltage source phi_oc(t) -> series source impedance Z0 -> series inductance L0 -> shunt capacitance C to ground (voltage phi_c) -> series inductance L1 -> parallel combination of the shunt loss resistor R_loss and the load inductance L_load; I_s is the source-branch current, I_l the load current.
circuit.shunt_resistor_model: R_loss(t) transitions from R_loss,i to R_loss,f through the logistic switch f(t) = 1/(1 + exp(-(t - t_loss)/dt_loss)) (Eqs. (19)-(20)).

voltage_trace.extraction_method: digitized (automated per-column pixel extraction) from the committed 300-dpi crop of Fig. 2 (arXiv:2209.14911v2 p. 2); reproducible via ground_truth/digitization_review/digitize_b6_voltage.py (calibration: frame spines -100/200 ns, y ticks 0/8 MV); per-column trace resampled to a 5-ns grid; QC overlay committed as digitization_review/extracted/B6_voltage_overlay.png -- flagged for human QC per ADR-0008

digitization_error.basis: curve line half-width (~3 px) plus frame/tick calibration (~1 px) on the 8 MV / 489.5 px y axis of ruiz_fig2_voltage_trace.png; time-axis reading error is ~1 ns (300 ns / 893 px)

consistency_checks.phi0_MV: extracted max 8.04 MV at t = 61 ns matches the Fig. 2 phi_0 dashed line at 8 MV
